title: [SUBS] Hamnet (2025) - Movie Streaming @ Netflix & Binge
body:
Deal: [SUBS] Hamnet (2025) - Movie Streaming @ Netflix & Binge

[Pidapipo] I loveeeeeeee this movie. We watched it at the theatre, walked out in daze (also eyes were too puffy due to crying lol), looked at each other and said it's only January, did 2026 cinema already peak just now?
Highly recommend. Both the lead actors gave a breathtaking performance.
[Pacify] Historical fictional drama, based on parts of Shakespeare's life.
Its a good film
[PVA] I dont want to block subscription movie deals.
But why is this particular movie a deal over other 2026 movies on strsaming services?
I genuinely want to know whats special with this one.
[Hiphopopotamus] It isn't, though maybe being critically acclaimed helps? Movies typically get posted when they first come to streaming services (subscriptions, not to buy or rent), I think this one took longer than usual because it first went to Peacock which we don't get in Australia.
[Unky] I don't think I'm the target audience for this movie
[Pacify] The target audience is anyone that likes "cinema". Though people might regard it too much like oscar bait, but its a very good art house film.
Despite the hilarity of Chloe Zhao directing The Eternals, her last 3 films ignoring the MCU slop were all well worth watching.
[R4] Good movie and all the main actors are White - a rarity in 21 st century revisionist/woke historical films.
